snapshot.title: XP curve research and implementation
snapshot.description: Research mobile game XP curves, validate proposed values, implement in AppController.gd. Target: L1-L3 within tutorial arc.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Research: review XP curves from comparable mobile games (Stardew, No Man's Sky, etc.)
Proposed curve reviewed and approved: L1-L3 achievable in tutorial, each level after progressively harder
Values implemented in AppController.gd
Mission XP rewards tuned to match curve (M1=80, M2=120, M3=160, M4=200 base)
Balance validated in playtest (L3 reached by end of tutorial arc)
